item.title: Metronom 3.1.1
item.description:
## What's new
Metronom 3.1.1 is now called just **Metronom** and polishes the time signature picker on macOS.
- **New name:** "Rask" is gone from the app's name — in the window title, the menu bar, About, the Linux applications menu, the Android launcher, the macOS disk image and the website. - **Time signature on macOS:** the highlight behind the selected number is taller, so it frames the number instead of clipping it.

item.title: Rask Metronom 3.1.0
item.description:
## What's new
Rask Metronom 3.1.0 has a website, in all the app's languages, and links to it from the app.
### Website
- **[rask-project.github.io/metronom](https://rask-project.github.io/metronom/)** shows every feature, the downloads and a guide to tempo, time signatures and note values, in English, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish, French and Italian. - **Try it in the browser:** choose a time signature, a note value and a tempo, see the bar the app plays and press play to hear it with the app's clicks.
### App
- **Help:** the new **?** button next to Settings opens the guide in the app's language. - **About** links to the website in the app's language.

item.title: Rask Metronom 3.0.0
item.description:
## What's new
Rask Metronom 3.0.0 looks native on macOS and reorganises the layout for phones in landscape.
### macOS
- **Native look:** buttons, switches, the BPM wheel and dialogs now follow the macOS style instead of Material. - Light and dark themes apply to the native controls too, with the app's orange accent. - Dialogs have a border and a shadow over a slightly dimmed page, so they stand out in both themes.
### Android
- **Landscape layout:** the metronome takes the left side and the note values, BPM and play controls stack on the right. The BPM wheel shows fewer rows when the screen is short. - Dialogs fit between the system bars, and the settings scroll when they do not fit. - Fixed the note value names being hard to read on the dark theme.
### Also
- Your light or dark choice is kept from the previous version.

item.title: Rask Metronom 2.0.0
item.description:
## What's new
Rask Metronom 2.0.0 adds time signatures and makes subdivisions follow the beat, like a real metronome.
### Time signatures
- **Choose the time signature** with the button next to play: 1 to 12 beats over a half, quarter or eighth note. - **Compound meters** (6/8, 9/8, 12/8) are counted in dotted quarters, each split in three eighths, and the BPM counts the dotted quarter. - Changes made while playing start on the next beat, so the count never breaks.
### Subdivisions
- The note value now divides **each beat**: in 4/4, eighths play 2 notes per beat, sixteenths 4 and thirty-seconds 8. - Only the note values that fit the beat are offered. Half notes are available in x/2 and dotted quarters in compound meters. - **Three clicks:** an accent on the first beat of the bar, a medium click on the other beats and a soft click on the subdivisions. - **The beat bar** shows one group per beat with a cell for each note, so you can see how many notes to play in that beat. - **The pendulum** swings once per beat instead of on every click. - Note icons use filled note heads, as in standard notation.
### Also
- Your time signature is remembered with the BPM and note value. - macOS: the translucent window follows the app's light or dark theme instead of the system's.

item.title: Rask Metronom 1.0.0
item.description:
## What's new
Rask Metronom 1.0.0 is the first release: a metronome for macOS, Linux and Android.
### Metronome
- **Sample-accurate timing.** Clicks are scheduled against the audio clock, so the beat never drifts. - **BPM control** with the classic tempo markings, from Largo to Prestissimo. - **Note values:** quarter, eighth, sixteenth and thirty-second notes, with an accented downbeat. - **Automatic BPM increase** at an interval you choose, for practising a passage faster and faster. - **Audio output selection** in Settings. - The screen stays awake while the metronome plays.
### Keyboard
- **Space** plays and stops. - **↑ / ↓** change the BPM by one. - **Page Up / Page Down** jump to the next or previous tempo marking. - **⌘,** opens Settings on macOS.
### macOS
- **Native window:** translucent and blurred, with the content extending under the title bar. - **Rask Metronom ▸ About** shows the version and the Qt it runs on. - **Automatic updates.** Once a day the app looks for a newer release, downloads it in the background and installs it when you quit. **Rask Metronom ▸ Check for Updates…** checks right away. Updates are signed and open without clearing the quarantine flag.
### Everywhere
- Light, dark or system theme. - Layout adapts to portrait and landscape. - English, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish, French and Italian. - Your BPM, note value, theme and language are remembered.
